Job Description

About TaskUs: TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.

The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.

It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.

What We Offer: At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.

Job Description

What can you expect in an Associate Data Engineer role with TaskUs: 

So what does an Associate Data Engineer do? Think of yourself as someone responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines, and data warehouses for use by the analytics infrastructure, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! We make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our employees are top-notch. So come on, now we need your full concentration because it's time to imagine what it's like being an Associate Data Engineer.

Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: you will assist in making accurate and meaningful data available for consumption of TaskUs Business Intelligence reporting methodology. As you tackle your new tasks for the day, you know that it will lead to one thing: that everything you do is to meet an enterprise's data delivery, business analysis, and reporting needs.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Associate Data Engineer, you will:

• Configure
• Configures and sets up solutions based on pre-approved patterns to move data from operational and external environments to the business intelligence environment.
• Management of data integration & ETL jobs - consolidation, aggregation, filtering, validation, data quality routines, dimension creation, etc.
• Configure and Deploy automation of jobs based on pre-approved and reusable patterns framework. Executes production-level jobs by considering data dependencies, schedules, validation routines, data stream updates.
• Design, develop and verify the data model according to the business requirements, and continuously optimize the model.
• Collaborate with technical users to define data requirements & establish business rules to be applied
• Collaborate with key business stakeholders to deliver and continually enhance the BI platform to provide relevant and accurate insights through the delivery of new datasets

• Test
• Validate and verify the data model according to the business requirements, and continuously optimize the model.
• Performs unit and system integration testing, on development projects.
• Undertaking peer reviews, assisting with testing, and ensuring documentation is current.

• Monitor
• Monitor Error Handling and Logging tools and processes. Troubleshoot configuration and data errors.
• Monitor Performance and raise appropriate flags.
• Identify opportunities to optimize the ETL environment, and implement monitoring, quality, and validation processes to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
Qualifications:

• At least 2 years of experience in Data Engineering.
• Knowledgeable with Python, Apache Kafka, AWS Redshift, AWS Glue, AWS S3, and Pentaho Data Integration.
• Strong knowledge of Data Warehousing concepts with understanding of traditional and MPP database designs, star and snowflake schemas with at least 2 years of data modeling.
• At least 2 years of hands-on development experience using ETL Tools such as Pentaho, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Fivetran or Airflow.
• Knowledge on the architecture, design and implementation of MPP Databases such as Teradata, Snowflake or Redshift.
• 3-year development using Cloud-based analytics solutions preferable AWS or GCP.
• Knowledge of designing and implementing streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, or Segment.
• Knowledgeable in Database Tuning and ETL tuning.
• Experience of using Python in a cloud-based environment is preferred.
• Knowledge on NoSQL DBs is preferred.
• Knowledge, experience and exposure to AI tools is preferred but not required.
• Someone who has the ability to work effectively across internal functional areas in ambiguous situations.
• Someone who is a structured thinker and effective communicator.

Education / Certifications:

• Bachelor's/College Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication) or 4-8 years experience in place of a degree.

Work Location / Work Schedule / Travel:

• Site Location: Any TaskUs IND Site (Remote)
• Work Setup: Work from Home

 How We Partner To Protect You: TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.

 DEI: In TaskUs we believe that innovation and higher performance are brought by people from all walks of life. We welcome applicants of different backgrounds, demographics, and circumstances. Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.

We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL https://www.taskus.com/careers/ . 

TaskUs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We celebrate and support diversity; we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. TaskUs people first culture thrives on it for the benefit of our employees, our clients, our services, and our community.

Job Summary 
Evalueserve is looking for high-potential finance professionals who are passionate about equity research, financial analysis, and investment decision-making. This role offers an opportunity to work with leading global asset managers, hedge funds and financial institutions, supporting critical investment research and valuation initiatives. The role offers hands-on exposure to company and industry analysis, financial modeling, valuation, and investment writing. Analysts will also leverage AI-enabled research and productivity tools to improve research efficiency and accelerate information synthesis, while applying sound financial judgment and independent thinking to generate actionable insights. This is an ideal opportunity for candidates seeking a challenging and rewarding career in investment research within a fast-paced, global environment.

Key Responsibilities 
• Support Equity Research team of a global asset manager in carrying out research on a portfolio of companies
• Conduct detailed company, industry, and financial research using publicly available information and financial databases.
• Build and maintain robust Excel-based financial models, including historical analysis, forecasting, and scenario modeling.
• Perform company valuations using methodologies such as DCF, DDM, trading comparable, transaction comparable, and other valuation frameworks.
• Prepare investment research deliverables including company profiles, earnings notes, quarterly updates, sector reports, thematic research, newsletters, flash notes, and industry primers. Summarize earnings calls, investor presentations, management interactions, and industry events to extract meaningful insights.
• Utilize AI-powered research and productivity tools, where appropriate, to enhance information gathering, analysis, monitoring, and content synthesis while ensuring analytical rigor and accuracy. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive research, data gathering, and monitoring tasks using AI solutions and workflow automation.

Required Qualifications 
• Relevant 6+ years of equity research experience with master’s degree
• MBA (Finance), CA, CFA (US) candidate, or equivalent finance-related qualification from a reputed institution.
• Subject matter expertise with rich domain expertise (financial modeling, sector / industry knowledge, and in investment research)
• Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial statement analysis, and corporate finance concepts.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce high-quality investment research content.
• Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively in a global team environment.
• Understanding of how technology and AI can be applied to enhance investment research workflows and analytical productivity.

Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have) 
• Prior exposure to equity research, investment research, valuation, corporate finance, consulting, or asset management.
• Familiarity with financial databases and research platforms such as Bloomberg, Capital IQ, FactSet, Refinitiv, or Reuters.
• Strong financial writing skills with the ability to communicate investment ideas and business insights effectively.
• Familiarity with AI-powered productivity and research tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.
• Ability to leverage AI tools for research, information extraction, summarization, and workflow efficiency while maintaining analytical rigor.
• Exposure to automation, agent-based workflows, or technology solutions that enhance research productivity will be an added advantage.
• A proactive "can-do" attitude, intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and strong ownership mindset.

We value candidates who combine strong financial acumen and investment judgment with a curiosity for emerging technologies that enhance research quality, efficiency, and decision-making.

About team: 

Chanakya is Sarvam AI's specialised, self-contained vertical for national security and institutions of national importance. It carries its own pricing, business, product, engineering, custom-model and vendor functions under one roof — a complete unit built to solve the most complex problems in the strategic sector: the three armed forces, intelligence agencies, financial regulators, and institutions of national importance such as central ministries and national policy bodies.
What we deploy here must be at strategic parity or higher — anything less is a national-security risk. That standard is the reason Chanakya is a small, exceptionally high-performing team inside Sarvam, and the reason we are deliberate about who joins it.
Why this is one of the most consequential seats in Indian AI
01 — NATIONAL IMPACT
You sit where it all gets decided.
These systems are deployed inside the institutions that safeguard the country. The potential for national impact is not abstract — it is at the core of how the strategic sector reasons, decides, and acts. Few roles anywhere in Indian technology carry this weight.
02 — UNPARALLELED LEARNING
Full-stack, end to end — nowhere else does this exist.
Every deployment runs the entire stack: understanding a customer's real requirement, architecting and customising the stack for it, and where needed building and fine-tuning models, shaping training data, and inventing data representations for extraordinarily complex data, workflows and applications. You touch nearly the whole arc of the work. This experience sets you apart — whether you go on to found a company, or become a business or technology leader in the years ahead, at Sarvam or beyond.
03 — A PATH TO LEADERSHIP
These are leadership seats in the making.
Chanakya's functions are being built out now. We are looking for people who will grow into the leaders of these emerging functions — every one of these roles is a route to leading a part of the vertical, not just filling it.
Where we are. This is not a leap into the unknown. Chanakya has already achieved product–market fit to a meaningful degree, has significant revenue booked, and has large strategic projects officially underway. Things are structured and going well.
The opportunity. This is a genuine zero-to-one journey — but one taken within the reach, talent and standing of a company like Sarvam. You get the ambition and ownership of building something new, backed by the full weight of Sarvam's capability and presence. The golden opportunity: to help build out and lead the emerging functions of Chanakya, with a clear growth path ahead. 
 
Product Manager (4–8 years)
Zero-to-one builders for a next-generation defence decision-support product.
We are building a next-generation decision-support product for defence users and need product leaders who have genuinely taken something from zero to one — conceived, built, and shipped a product to real users, not managed a roadmap on an established one.
• A hands-on, prototyping instinct — comfortable putting something rough in front of users quickly.
•Stayed in the line of building tech products; strong AI-first instinct — reasoning about what
models make newly possible.
•Comfortable with ambiguity, senior institutional users, air-gapped deployments, and frequent
travel to client sites. Much of the product definition will be theirs to make.
 
The bar. Across every one of these roles, we are looking for people who want to change the world and build something of national consequence — and who will grow into the leaders of Chanakya's verticals. If that is you, the ceiling here is set only by your ambition.
Base: Delhi NCR, with travel across India. All roles involve working inside restricted environments and travelling to client sites at short notice.
